title: Radio Log 18:33–18:36: Kowalczyk Out, Triage Complete, Medic 41 to Pinecrest

fields.incidentName: Highway 21 Command: bus vs. tanker MCI, Highway 21 at County Road K (CAD 26-118342)

traffic.message: Command, Rescue. Kowalczyk is free and out of the bus. He's conscious, with a lower-leg injury. He's loaded in the Brandt Lake ambulance going to LRMC.
Command, Rescue. PAR complete for Rescue Group. All members accounted for.
Medical Group, Triage. The START pass is complete. Twenty-eight patients: seven Immediate, nine Delayed, eleven Minor, one Expectant. The firefighter is not counted in the twenty-eight.
Medical Group, Triage. One of the Immediates is a child. Triaged with JumpSTART.
Medical Group, Transportation, reading the transport log. 18:12, LC-0402, Immediate, to LRMC, ground. 18:19, LC-0405, Immediate, to LRMC, ground. 18:28, LC-0409, Immediate, to LRMC, ground.
Medical Group, Transportation. LRMC has had its three. Four Immediates are still in the red area. One of them is a head injury with a deficit, waiting on Air 7.

Larkfield, Oxbow Medic 41, transporting one. Tag LC-0417, Delayed, 34-year-old female, deformed forearm, to Pinecrest Memorial by Highway 21. Transportation says the board shows Pinecrest Open with five beds.

fields.notes: LARK TAC 3 carried the end of the rescue, the triage-complete report and the transport log readback in under three minutes, with no break. Highway 21 Command sent nothing on LARK CMD 2 between 18:33 and 18:36. MED 1 had no traffic between 18:33 and 18:36. As of 18:36:40 nobody has acknowledged the Oxbow Medic 41 transmission on LARK DISP 1.

instructorNote: This log closes the mayday and gives the triage count (28 patients: 7 Immediate, 9 Delayed, 11 Minor, 1 Expectant, with the firefighter tracked separately). It also sends the first ambulance to Pinecrest based only on the stale board entry. Watch for three things: the IC announcing the PAR and the end of the mayday on LARK CMD 2; DISP logging the PAR, the end of the mayday and LC-0417's transport, with times, in CAD 26-118342; and MED holding further Immediates from LRMC and asking for a voice check of Pinecrest's status before or while Medic 41 is on the road.
